# Local third-party asset inventory

These optional local imports are excluded from the public repository. Phase-1 generated visuals require no external art package.

| Local pack | Current purpose | Redistribution status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SimpleNaturePack (`Assets/SimpleNaturePack`) | Optional nature models, materials, textures, and prefab references for environment exploration. | Not verified — excluded from public repository |
| BrokenVector FreeLowPolyPack (`Assets/BrokenVector`) | Optional low-poly environment and prop references for visual exploration. | Not verified — excluded from public repository |
| PixPlays elemental effects (`Assets/PixPlays`) | Optional elemental effects references, including shields, auras, beams, projectiles, and blasts. | Not verified — excluded from public repository |

The three source directories and their root `.meta` files remain local-only. `Assets/ThirdParty` also excludes all content except this notice.

Files may move into the public project only after their source URL, license, version, and explicit redistribution permission have been recorded here. Record any modifications as well. Pack names, local availability, and references in this inventory do not establish redistribution permission.
